record.title: Armenia national pandemic land-passenger restrictions
record.direction: Foreign land entry and initially Armenian citizen land exit
record.exceptions: Citizens, eligible family members/legal residents, diplomats and close relatives attending funerals; cargo and train crews; special permission from the border commander
record.enforcement: MFA states legal prohibition; government amendment reported through UNECE permits entry 12 January 2021.
record.record_type: national policy; follows earlier Iran-specific phase
record.status_observation: Formal permission or repeal dated by evidence; operational resumption is not independently established for the full stated scope.
record.context: Emergency restrictions 16 March followed by quarantine successor 11 September; same continuing policy family.
record.uncertainty: 16 March official announcement establishes national phase; preceding Iran closure CC006 overlaps. 12 January 2021 is legal foreign-entry easing, not separately observed field passage or proof of all citizen-exit changes.
